editorial.blurb: A vibrant neighborhood spot serving fresh, made-to-order sandwiches, burgers, and desserts with genuinely warm hospitality and a welcoming vibe.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the spicy Italian or steak and cheese sub fresh—reviewers rave about how juicy and freshly cooked they are, and arrive early if you need parking in the city.

topDishes.note: Best burger reviewers have had in a long time
